verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS content platform like Egnyte, but the evidence never documents a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of the core product. The only related item is hybrid storage, which connects on-premises file servers and NAS to Egnyte's service. That is an adjacent feature, not self-hosting the product itself. missing for 10: any documented self-hosted or on-prem deployment option for the core Egnyte product, installation/deployment docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Hybrid storage - connects on-premises file servers, NAS devices, and public cloud storage through a single governed namespace
